title: The Inventory Value export shows the same net figures as the screen
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in, and bin {Bin-B} is a second bin at {Location-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BIN-B).
  • Every part in this case is tracked and costs $10.00 per unit.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-IVNET-EXP-01) is active at {Location-A}, with 5 in {Bin-A} and -2 in {Bin-B}.
  • Inventory part {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-IVNET-EXP-02) is active at {Location-A}, with -2 in its only bin {Bin-A}.
  • Both part numbers start with {Prefix-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-IVNET-EXP-).
  • Line {Line-1} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL IV NET EXPORT MIXED") of work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) took 2 of {Part-A} from {Bin-B} while {Bin-B} held 0, which put {Bin-B} at -2.
  • Line {Line-2} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL IV NET EXPORT NEGATIVE") of work order {Work-order-2} (for example S2-15440) took 2 of {Part-B} from {Bin-A} while {Bin-A} held 0, which put {Bin-A} at -2.
  • A spreadsheet program or text editor is available to open a CSV file.
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Reports and open the Inventory Value report.
  2. Leave the as-of date on today.
  3. Set the Location filter to {Location-A} only.
  4. Type {Prefix-A} in the report's Search box.
  5. Read the rows listed (Qty, Unit Cost and Total Cost).
  6. Read the Totals row.
  7. Open the report's export menu and export as CSV.
  8. Open the CSV file and read the rows for {Part-A} and {Part-B} and the Totals line.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: {Part-A} Qty 3.00 and Total Cost $30.00; {Part-B} Qty -2.00 and Total Cost -$20.00.
  • Step 6: Totals Qty 1.00 and Total Cost $10.00 (3 + (-2) = 1; $30.00 + (-$20.00) = $10.00).
  • Step 8: The CSV gives the same figures: {Part-A} quantity 3 and total cost $30.00, {Part-B} quantity -2 and total cost -$20.00, and the Totals line quantity 1 and total cost $10.00; a negative amount is written with the minus before the $ (-$20.00).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; bug SV-10380 (Inventory Value report ignores negative bins and overstates net inventory value; Ready to Fix, updated 9 Oct 2026; ships with this epic per Chris Ward's comments of 24 Sep and 7 Oct 2026), description, reproduction table and acceptance criteria, read 13 Oct 2026; PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), §2 Accounting, read 13 Oct 2026; QA lead's set-up answers of 9 Oct 2026 (situation 1: a bin below zero). Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • SV-10380 acceptance criteria: “Report rows, aggregate totals, exports and newly captured snapshots use the same net quantity basis for the same scope and cutoff. Quantity-dependent displayed values use that same basis.”
